docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Actuaries are Data Engineers
docs.text:
Whether you like it or not, if you're an actuary, you're probably a data engineer .

You once let slip that you did a Udemy course on SQL and databases and now you've found yourself as the "one who pulls".

Don't fight it - I can show you how you go from sql scripts stored on your desktop to fully automated pipelines.
